tests.name: All ten showcase views bind Core Model directly and fit the viewport
Pointer expansion writes nested model state and ARIA
Pointer ranges, additive row selection, select all and Escape
Rectangular cell selection follows source-column indexes
F2 editing, Enter commit, Escape cancel, undo and redo
Numeric conversion and validation retain the editor on failure
Arrow, Page, Ctrl+Home/End and type-to-search navigation
Three-state header sorting preserves model selection
Column resize with actual pointer input
Native header drag reorders source columns
Context menu and live column visibility
Templates initialize, update, edit and retain three-state checkboxes
TSV round-tripping, transactional paste, undo and safe CSV output
Observable add/remove, filtering and empty state
Variable-height distant scrolling remains contiguous and bounded
ResizeObserver tracks live content growth and shrinkage
100,000 rows: jump, tail reachability, bounded DOM and recycling
One million rows: scaled scrollbar reaches beyond CSS extent limits
200 columns: horizontal virtualization, pinned cells and header alignment
Shared source, direct row identity, independent widths and nested binding
Detach suspends bindings; reattach resynchronizes without disposing the model
Native row drag moves an item between hierarchical groups
Auto width converges instead of feeding back stretched flex widths
Serializable view-state save and restoration
Model strings render as text, never executable HTML
Light, dark and narrow responsive layouts
Cancellable selection and edit-start events
Recycled template handlers target the new model, not the old row
Additional custom-element tag registration
No uncaught browser exceptions
